part.text:
The images are ready. The workspace defines exactly one view, so there is one image:

- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the System Context view, in C4 style: the **Patron** person (blue, `#0E70C1`) → **Library** software system (`#1168BD`), with the "Browses the catalogue through" / *HTTPS* relationship, title, and a Person / Software System legend.

How it was produced, and one caveat:

1. I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling (source kept at `/work/SystemContext.puml`).
2. This container has **no internet access** (DNS is blocked, only the local Docker network is reachable) and **no local renderer** (no Java, Python, Node, or ImageMagick), so I couldn't hit the PlantUML server for a PNG. Since you allowed SVG, I generated the diagram as a hand-authored SVG following C4 conventions.

If you want a PNG, in any environment with PlantUML installed, just run:

```
plantuml SystemContext.puml
```

That will produce `SystemContext.png` from the exact exported source.
